thread.title_full: Repairs to Houston Avenue Bridge after being struck by trucks will cause weekend road closures - NewsBreak

author: Caroline Wilburn
title: Repairs to Houston Avenue Bridge after being struck by trucks will cause weekend road closures - NewsBreak
text:
By Caroline Wilburn Octavia Johnson ,
3 hours ago Traffic moves along Interstate 10 under the Houston Avenue bridge on Wednesday, July 27, 2022 in Houston. The Texas Department of Transportation has proposed a $347 million project to elevate the freeway from Heights Boulevard to Interstate 45, to avoid portions near White Oak Bayou flooding during heavy rains. (Brett Coomer, Houston Chronicle / Staff photographer) Emergency repairs for the Houston Avenue Bridge, which has been struck three times in recent weeks , will cause several road closures this weekend, according to the Texas Department of Transportation.
Repairs are scheduled to begin 9 p.m. Friday through 5 a.m. Monday, causing several closures on the Interstate 10 Katy Freeway and Interstate 610 West Loop, according to TxDOT.
The bridge has been struck and damaged by several trucks in recent weeks, most recently on Monday .
In addition to closures on I-10 and I-610, the north and southbound lanes of the Houston Avenue Bridge at I-10 will be closed. Drivers heading north will detour by turning right on Crockett Street, turning left on North Main Street, turning left on Quitman Street and turning right onto Houston Avenue. Drivers heading southbound will detour by turning left on Quitman Street, turning right on North Fulton Street, turning right on Hogan Street and turning left onto Houston Avenue.

I-10 Katy Freeway eastbound from Shepherd/Durham Drive to Houston Avenue Exit to the eastbound I-10 Frontage Road. Turn left on Shepherd Drive. Turn left on the I-10 westbound Frontage Road. Take the next ramp and follow the I-10 westbound frontage road to the I-610 West Loop northbound connector to I-610 North Loop eastbound. Take I-45 southbound connector to I-10 eastbound. I-10 Katy Freeway eastbound from Antoine Drive to Shepherd Drive { "__type": "devHubFreeformEmbed", "__id": "Datawrapper", "__fallbackImage": "https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/rcmju/mobile.png", "__data": { "datawrapper_id": "rcmju" } } All four left lanes of the I-10 Katy Freeway will be closed with one lane remaining open for local traffic only, according to TxDOT. Drivers are encouraged to pursue alternative routes, but can detour.
Take the I-610 West Loop northbound connector to the I-610 North Loop eastbound connector. Continue onto I-610 North Loop eastbound. Take the I-45 southbound connector to I-10 eastbound. I-610 West Loop north, southbound connector ramp to I-10 Katy Freeway eastbound connector { "__type": "devHubFreeformEmbed", "__id": "Datawrapper", "__fallbackImage": "https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/MHm5m/mobile.png", "__data": { "datawrapper_id": "MHm5m" } } Take I-10 westbound and exit at Chimney Rock. Make a U-turn to I-10 eastbound. Continue onto I-10 eastbound to the I-610 West Loop northbound connector. Continue on I-610 and take the I-45 southbound connector. Take I-45 southbound to I-10. How are officials planning to change Houston Avenue Bridge? There are plans for the reconstruction of the Houston Avenue Bridge as part of the Interstate-10 elevation project. The project will focus on raising the interstate's main lanes between Heights Boulevard and Interstate 45 to alleviate flooding issues. Houston Avenue will be rebuilt to run under I-10.
TxDOT plans to start construction for the Houston Avenue portion of the project in early 2027.
The Houston Avenue Bridge passed a recent inspection in December 2024 that found no major structural damage despite the repeated hits, according to a federal database that catalogues every bridge in the U.S.
